text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oryaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...*gasp*! *pant*, *pant*, haaaaaah!!

One morning. Tamamo Cross was engaged in 
intense special training alongside a 
familiar-looking Horse Girl!

Tamamo Cross's training was so brutal that 
underclassmen dropped out after just one 
day. Yet, that Horse Girl was clinging on 
through sheer willpower.

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *huff*—Not yet! I'm runnin' one 
more lap!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha, right? That kid's grit is truly 
ironclad.

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
T-Tama-senpai! Won't you please make me 
your apprentice~!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? —Wait, what!? You're that brat 
pickin' fights on the track!? Where's this 
comin' from all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
See... I could never win, no matter what! 
I thought working hard was totally 
pointless! But! Seeing you run, 
Tama-senpai, it just blew me away!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...How the heck can you talk so much while 
liftin' a barbell...?

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *huff*...! Please make me your... 
disciple...!!

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
This time... I don't wanna give up! I 
wanna pull off that explosive late spurt 
just like you, Senpai... and seize glory 
for myself!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up givin' in to her 
passion. Haha!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...She really keeps up with me, y'know. 
With *my* trainin', of all things.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I honestly thought nobody could ever copy 
it...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Past or future, this running style belongs 
to me alone...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But with her... maybe she really could 
carry on my runnin' style...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Just kiddin'! Ahaha! Well, she's still a 
total greenhorn! Don't you go tellin' her 
any of that, got it?
choice_data_list: Yep, let's keep it between us.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Heheh, countin' on ya!

However, some time later— I came across 
Tamamo Cross confronting her junior with a 
solemn expression.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You can't become like me.

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My runnin' style... just ain't suited for 
you...

text_block_list.name: Ex-Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
No way... Why, why!? I'll keep following 
you! I'll do anything!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's no use. You'd better stop tryin' to 
copy me.

Having been told their apprenticeship was 
over, the junior's shoulders trembled as 
she turned and ran back toward the school 
building.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ? ...What is it?
choice_data_list: Didn't you have high hopes for her?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Inari told me the exact same 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Don't talk nonsense! You're the one who 
took that girl under your wing in the 
first place, ain'tcha!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I know that. I know it full well 
without you tellin' me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But... watchin' her run lately made me 
realize somethin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Where she can truly shine right now— it 
ain't on the turf. It's dirt.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Her guts are top-notch, and she drives her 
legs hard. I can't let her waste away 
copyin' me on turf!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So—I'm beggin' you, Inari. Make her shine 
on the sand!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
............I see. ...Swallowin' your 
tears for her sake, huh.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Can't help it then—I'll take the job! 
Yours truly, Inari-sama, will guide her 
down the right path!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—So that's how it went down. Inari oughta 
call out to her sometime tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A fresh start... I know she's gonna get 
way stronger!
choice_data_list: Did you explain that to her?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A fresh start... I know she's gonna get 
way stronger!
choice_data_list: Did you explain that to her?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha, no way! I ain't sayin' a word! Don't 
wanna burden her with weird feelings of 
responsibility, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine this way. Long as she gets 
stronger, that's all that matters!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Though I went and pawned the rest 
off on Inari!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Runnin' on sand should be a piece 
of cake for her, right? ...I'm countin' on 
ya, Inari!
